name: Fresh Flowers
source:
Down-on-their-luck Harry and Gerry decide to try and make some quick money selling flowers in Fantastico Park one pleasant day.  Unfortunately, a bee may have other plans for them.

[From [url=https://heavenshire-stories.itch.io/fresh-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
运气不佳的哈利和格里决定在一个愉快的日子里尝试在幻想公园卖花赚点快钱。不幸的是，蜜蜂可能对它们有其他计划。

[来自[url=https://heavenshire-stories.itch.io/fresh-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
